title: The perfection of the structure sheaf in characteristic p lies in the essential image of the h-topology pushforward
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma places the perfection O^{perf} = colim_F O of the structure sheaf of a scheme over F_p in the essential image of the pushforward from the h-topology (statement lines 23650-23656). The proof (proof lines 23658-23705) verifies the h-criterion configuration by configuration: it computes the fppf cohomology of the perfection as a filtered colimit and identifies it with the Zariski cohomology of O, then for each almost blow-up square of the flatness chapter kills the higher cohomology by affineness or by the funny blow-up lemma, reducing the check to the short exact sequence of sections of O^{perf} supplied by the flatness-chapter lemmas. H2: one criterion reduction applied to a finite list of explicit squares.
